model: Unchanged V31 segment duration model, July 25 training, 20 second grid
data: Existing July 16 and 17 development archives; no independent confirmation claim
selection: screen.py saves schedule-only roots and denominators before replay
information: The common prefix attempts one statically fixed first vehicle from start; unavailable service costs the deadline. No observations of other vehicles at the origin are carried. Onboard decisions observe only own arrivals. Local platform departures are observed from entry through departure; observations stop when leaving. No external forecast is supplied. Vehicle paths are drawn once per trip and reused at every candidate occurrence.
actions: All retained first-vehicle alighting hubs, all retained tail variants, up to two transfers. Tail variant is selected at boarding; the final platform uses first legal offer.
full_hub_seed_formula: base_seed + 1000 * root_index; initial capped probe used base_seed + root_index
menu_expansion: The same twelve roots are also evaluated with all their original eight-leg-prefix hubs. The initial three-hub cap makes one-step rollout structurally sufficient in a chain; expansion removes this artificial limitation without selecting on outcomes.
reference_scope: Standard chain stopping is exact for supplied tail-value tables and the first vehicle chain. Tail values are independently sampled physical policy costs; report quadrature uncertainty. The small exact waiting table is only a fixed-mark surrogate when tail trips overlap root offers. All eighteen overlapping platforms additionally receive public-history-conditioned two-target replay; this forced-arrival diagnostic is reported separately from full-root evaluation.
comparison: No per-realization best-policy selection. The primary baseline is rolling two-target tail control with one-step onboard rollout. Preserve all paired wins, losses, missing labels and unsupported histories.
continuation: A new algorithm requires a reproducible residual beyond standard chain stopping and cheap controls, with identifiable legal predecision information and a demonstrated computation bottleneck. Otherwise retain the baselines and stop algorithm admission; do not consume new dates.
